market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the 2024 IPL champions and typically field a competitive team. In a 10-team league, a top-tier team should have at least an 8-10% chance. The market's implied 2% probability severely underestimates their chances, offering clear value on YES.
evidence_points: KKR won the 2024 IPL title, showing strong roster and management.
Historically, IPL winning probabilities for top teams cluster around 10% due to league parity.
No known catastrophic events (e.g., core player exodus, ban) that would justify a 2% price.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of IPL team count and parity
